entities.summary: Carl William Stalling was an American composer, voice actor and arranger for music in animated films. He is most closely associated with the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies shorts produced by Warner Bros. Cartoons, where he averaged one complete score each week, for 22 years. Carl W. Stalling was a composers & musicians from Lexington (1891-11-10, Lexington–1972-11-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
